odyssey.title: The Warlord
odyssey.character_basis: Proud, steadfast veteran and loyal commander; direct rifle fights with dependable support.
odyssey.behavior_source: authored persona + native bot AI; not a neural model or pro recording
odyssey.voice_owner: Tom; existing ElevenLabs voice mapped by clone_id; no voice IDs embedded

quirks.name: The direct challenge
quirks.effect: Native aggression 58/100; pressure appetite, not a guaranteed path.

quirks.name: The loyal commander
quirks.effect: Native teamwork 85/100; squad preference when teammates exist.

quirks.name: A fair reaction window
quirks.effect: Configured reaction 320 ms, subject to the native AI and server tick.

quirks.name: The steady veteran
quirks.effect: Aim offset scale 0.35; finite acceleration cap 12000. Calibration required.

quirks.name: Sets his shot
quirks.effect: Configured attack delay 80 ms after the native AI decides to engage.

quirks.name: Controlled rifle volleys
quirks.effect: Burst target 5 shots, single-shot share 25%; existing trigger suppression.

quirks.name: The planted shield
quirks.effect: Extra crouch at burst start with probability 50%; native crouching can also occur.

quirks.name: Grounded veteran
quirks.effect: 0.5 extra jumps/min target while running outside combat; zero means no injected jumps.

quirks.name: Disciplined approach
quirks.effect: 45% walk chance per eligible second near a recent heard step/reload; memory 3s. Not global enemy awareness.

quirks.name: The dependable rifle
quirks.effect: Full-buy primary T/CT: ak47/m4a1; subject to money and alias support.

quirks.name: The practical sidearm
quirks.effect: Eco sidearm T/CT: p250/p250; no armor/utility splurge.

quirks.name: The affordable battle line
quirks.effect: Force primary T/CT: galilar/famas, then vest; subject to affordability.

quirks.name: Straightforward support
quirks.effect: Utility buy palette: flashbang, hegrenade. Native AI chooses deployment; no authored lineups or fakes.

quirks.name: Armor before ornament
quirks.effect: Primary then vesthelm before utility, both sides; a protected but normally killable veteran.
